requirements.title: Analysis Breadth
requirements.description: Caption/alt-text, object detection/tagging, anonymous face detection (no recognition), quality assessment, duplicate/near-dup detection (perceptual hash), embedding generation, and QR/barcode read. SHIPPED (pure-Go, runs on any host): quality_assessment returns decoded pixel dimensions plus no-reference sharpness/exposure/contrast heuristics; duplicate_detect returns DCT pHash + aHash fingerprints. Both use AnalyzeResponse result types and the analyze edge; CLI commands are `analyze quality` and `analyze duplicate`. REMAINING (forward-declared, seeded, not yet wired): caption, object_detection, tagging, face_detection (no recognition), embedding, qr_barcode_read — model/library-backed.
